criteria.requirement: Fixed-bed lake at rest with slope/curvature combinations
criteria.gap: Direct production residuals now cover flat, smooth, seeded rough and strong-ramp Q1 lakes with all slope/curvature combinations. Coverage remains one liquid closure and a constant boundary collar, not arbitrary boundaries or all compositions.

criteria.requirement: No uphill leakage and refinement behavior
criteria.gap: Short excavation is t=0.001 s; Gate-H extends to t=0.1 s but is one liquid configuration, not a full benchmark hierarchy.

criteria.requirement: Reconstruction positivity, compatible mean momentum and velocity bounds
criteria.gap: Complete active 2-D normal/tangential traces, auxiliary velocities and normal momentum means are compared to pinned cores for the liquid fixture. Broader variable-composition and near-singular production traces remain untested.

criteria.requirement: Smooth, rough and seeded random continuous Q1 beds in 1D and 2D
criteria.gap: Direct dynamic 2-D residuals are covered on smooth and PCG64-seeded rough beds, including drainage and sparse wet/dry worksets. Separate 1-D production dynamics, refinement and full trajectories remain open.

criteria.requirement: Variable-composition transport and signed component conservation
criteria.gap: Local closure/flux tests pass independently of a dynamic mixed solid/gas/liquid transport and component-budget regression.

criteria.requirement: Production semidiscrete residual, CFL and time integration against clean reference
criteria.gap: Complete liquid-fixture residuals and directional CFL bounds are compared to unchanged pinned cores. Retained IMEX uses min(dt_x,dt_y), while the SSPRK2 reference uses the harmonic combination: the combined timestep does NOT match. Stage admissibility/order and mixed-closure reference comparisons remain open.

criteria.requirement: Mass conservation and symmetry
criteria.gap: Current tolerances cover Gate-H mass and G=1 lateral symmetry; include component budgets, other boundary/source cases and analytical 1-D dynamics.

criteria.requirement: Real one/four-thread equivalence
criteria.gap: Direct spatial/CFL payloads and existing full trajectories check actual 1/4 teams and bitwise equality. This does not cover every physical model or future distributed execution.

criteria.requirement: Exact deterministic and stochastic continuation
criteria.gap: Require both original-duration trajectories to finish; do not replace a failed long stochastic run with a shortened one.

criteria.requirement: Solid availability, substrate inventory and source-mask limits before nodal averaging
criteria.gap: Production two-solid liquid cases saturate deposition/erosion/loss and assert all inventories, thermal sources, cutoff and radial/fissural masks. Gas, pore-pressure, vaporization and geometric source-overlap regimes remain separate coverage gaps.

criteria.requirement: Mass-lumped global bed-volume identity including dry cells and boundaries
criteria.gap: Limited production proposals are checked with independent Q1 nodal quadrature on a rectangular 8x7 mesh, including dry/listed and wet/inactive cells and all boundaries. Broader mesh/model regimes remain untested.

criteria.requirement: Exact B_vertex restart with bed evolution
criteria.gap: Production checkpoint read/write and a second nonzero exchange update are checked bitwise for q, bed and inventories. Coverage is the controlled liquid fixture plus the configured full-solver restart case, not all model regimes.

criteria.requirement: Authoritative nodal bed and refreshed geometry after bed modifications
criteria.gap: Independent center/face, LS slope/curvature and G checks follow every nonzero production update and a real checkpoint read with poisoned geometry caches. This does not establish dynamic closure correctness for every geometry/model.

criteria.requirement: Wet/dry local geometric mismatch is diagnosed
criteria.gap: Production signed/L1/Linf reductions and bed-volume-rate units are checked independently, including nonzero dry/inactive mismatch. Broader wet/dry and evolving-bed dynamic acceptance remains open.

criteria.requirement: HP-PCCU is the sole production backend with canonical state/thermal conventions
criteria.gap: Source inspection supports cutover; acceptance also requires all relevant numerical/model gates and versioned output contracts.

criteria.requirement: Pinned source, tools, compiler flags, inputs, outputs and reference checksums
criteria.gap: Recorded hashes are observations, not approved golden outputs. Clean reference package provenance must be verified separately.

criteria.requirement: Clean strict/debug and optimized validation
criteria.gap: Unit scripts retain their own compilation policy; Froude, mass-exchange and spatial-operator scripts also build strict and optimized production modules. Full production-executable runs exercise both audited profiles. M12c automation/portability remains separate.

criteria.requirement: Explicit tolerances and comparator policy
criteria.gap: Use existing per-test limits without relaxing them. Historical KT outputs are not the current production comparator; complete approved tolerance/reference inventory.

criteria.requirement: Long ETNA/lava acceptance and regression ownership
criteria.gap: User reported successful long runs; inputs, executable provenance, quantitative limits and outputs are not pinned in this audit.

criteria.requirement: Scientific baseline sign-off
criteria.gap: N9 remains open until failures and required coverage gaps are resolved and baseline approval is explicit.

criteria.requirement: Examples, source inputs, versioned restart and scientific output metadata match canonical semantics
criteria.gap: Local inlet/fissure geometry tests and checkpoint equality do not cover end-to-end fissural injection budgets, decoded NetCDF fields or metadata/schema compatibility.

spatial_operator_production_evidence.scope: Direct public production API, pure liquid closure with one zero solid component, constant boundary collar, no IMEX advancement.
spatial_operator_production_evidence.tolerance: 8192 * epsilon(float64) * scale; scale=max(1,max(abs(reference))) except lake residual uses rho_c*g*max(1,hmax^2)/min(dx,dy).
spatial_operator_production_evidence.profile_and_thread_policy: Strict and optimized production modules, floating-point traps in both, strictly compiled assertion driver, actual teams 1 and 4.
spatial_operator_production_evidence.scope_completion: Direct operator and directional-bound comparisons pass. Combined timestep and full IMEX stage/order acceptance remain open.
